notes.title: Combat Overrun major game mode update!
notes.notes:
Combat Overrun receives its largest update yet, with a revamped spawning method into its unique game mode - Battle Supreme! Players now enter an automated VTOL carrier at spawn - blasting across the map, slowing down at desirable spawn locations. Players can jump off at any time, gauging the possible fall damage if too high up - vs the possible reward of being the first to get to weapons and vehicles on the ground. The VTOL can be shot down - although difficult to do - another thing players want to consider.

Full update list;

* New spawning method into Battle Supreme - VTOL carrier drop off
* Improved world graphics with erosion shading on terrain
* Improved ragdoll physics
* Fixed bug with rockets / tank shells not detonating on player impact
* Added display of weapons/ammo/items pickup names, green for possible pickup
* Improved helicopter flight model
* Increased sprint speed - now further picks up speed beyond initial run velocity
* Fixed bug with keyboard input not allowing for background keyboard volume controls
* Improved stability during loading phase of the game world

As we rapidly march on towards the full release of the game - which we aim to deliver with features beyond what has been promised - enjoy the updates in the meantime and join in and build a community!

notes.title: Optimization update went live today!
notes.notes:
We have been working hard on optimizing and tuning the game engine, and are happy to announce that we have achieved a quite massive performance boost, on top of an already fast game!

The optimizations have boosted framerate and most significantly smoothness, especially in networked games by a large margin, absorbing physics and networking spikes much better.

Enjoy guys and remember that we are in this for the long run, we will keep hammering out the updates all the way to the launch of the full game! :)

/the Combat Overrun team

notes.title: Huuge update to the game today! Furious Deathmatch added!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

As promised the core gameplay mode of Combat Overrun - a fast and furious deathmatch mode with vehicles and guns in abundance - has now been fully enabled!

Have fun and see you in the game!

/Combat Overrun team

notes.title: Another update to the game went live today!
notes.notes:
We continue to do rapid-fire updates to the game, delivering on feedback and to-be-expected Early Access improvements and additions;

* Added follow mode free-cam for all vehicles, allowing for blasting down those mountain roads while looking around for targets
* Tweaked vehicle physics to be able to increase top speed and maintain realism
* Added new populated area of the map

Thanks for your support guys!

/Tanks And Guns team

notes.title: An update to the game is now live!
notes.notes:
We've made some changes and improvements;

* Option to turn off Motion Blur added to Graphics Options
* Run speed increased by ~15%
* Spawning Tanks, Jeeps, Fast cars and Trucks is now toggleable at Create Server time! Customize your game server as you like.

Cheers,

The Tanks And Guns team
